title: Finding Cross-Round Identity Status
description: A finding's position in the cross-round iteration lifecycle — is it new, still open, fixed, came back, or acknowledged-not-fixed. Orthogonal to tracked-status.schema.json (where a fix currently sits in the human/tech-pair workflow) — a finding can be REGRESSED and simultaneously back IN_PROGRESS; these are two independent axes, never conflated into one enum. Extracted from review-finding-report.schema.json so every review/report contract shares one definition. Value domain only; the lifecycle SEMANTICS live in review-report-standards.
